audit.why: Pantheon owns levels 1-5; the lane inverts at 6 (Moonfall pull + shield + reset) and stays Diana's through items. Content layer and packet chart agree; 47.66% WR fits.
Spikes present and ordered right: 3-5 Pantheon all-in window, 6 Diana inversion, her 1st item duel, her 2-item diver scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content claims Diana 'has no gap-close until 6' — Lunar Rush is her E, a basic-ability dash (22/20/18/16/14s, reset by Moonlight marks), not part of her ult. Full chart carried blanket Skill while content/packet agree on Pantheon x4 / Diana x3. 13 misgender hits, two bleed bullets, digitless cooldowns.
audit.why: Enemy kit: Q 8s leaves Moonlight which makes E cooldown-free onto marked targets; W Pale Cascade shields (stun still lands through it); R Moonfall is the level-6 spike. The correct all-in gate is 'Q mark and E spent', not 'no dash before 6'.
audit.corrected: Gap-close claims rewritten around Lunar Rush and the Moonlight reset; chart rows aligned to content with grounded whys; pronouns, bleeds and cooldown digits fixed.

edits.after: Pre-6 you out-brawl her: E Aegis Assault blocks her Q Crescent Strike, W Shield Vault stuns straight through her Pale Cascade shield, and Q plus autos win every short trade. edits.before: Levels 3-6 start in your favour and flip at 6. Through 5, all-in her whenever Q is down and she has no escape; but the moment she has R Moonfall she pulls you in, shields, and her combo plus reset out-damages you. Respect the level-6 power spike and back off.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 start in your favour and flip at 6. Through 5, all-in when her Q is down — Lunar Rush without a Moonlight mark is a 20-second dash, so she cannot re-engage. The moment she has R Moonfall she pulls you in, shields, and out-damages you. Back off.
